name: Priscilu: The Trader
teaser: Real Gunsmith is Back.. Now with Quests  and Custom bags!
description_html:
PRISCILU REQUIRES VCQL

A distinguished gunsmith who smuggles some of the best weapons and equipment into Tarkov. Also he is excellent in repairing weapons and armor.

New kid on the block again!!!!

Is he a trader? Yes, he is!

Is he a smuggler? Yes, he is!

Is he a gunsmith? Yes, he is!

Is he a repair man? Yes, he is!

Priscilu is the guy you must look for if you want to go to Tarkov equipped with the best gear.

Besides, Priscilu is well known for his excellent job in repairing weapons and armor. Some say he provides the best repair service in Tarkov.

Known Bugs

  • Always read the version description when updating the mod.
  • If mission zones don’t work, There is an error in mod installation, you need to re-install VCQL, and Priscilu.
  • SPT Realism Mod restricts Priscilu Trader’s all stock and gives an error message “Munitions expert detected, it is not compatible”. You need to make the necessary regulations from SPT Realism Mod settings.

Installation

  1. Install VCQL
  2. Install Priscilu
  3. Open the downloaded file
  4. Select the folder in the .rar file
  5. Drag the user folder from winrar into your SPT folder
